workDescription: Phase 09 of the Veent HRIS UI/UX overhaul — login step 1 stops listing every Organization to anonymous visitors and becomes email-first. The server resolves the account's org(s) and returns one response shape for every email; only a 2+-org email gets a picker. Two source files, seven test files, three process artifacts. No schema, service, capability, rate-limiter or dependency change.
approver: vc-validate-agent (outer PVL, CONDITIONAL with 9 binding execute instructions E1-E9); owner rulings of 2026-09-03 binding throughout
why: The only phase in the program that changes an authentication flow. It rewrites the login form actions, moves org resolution server-side, and changes which org a session lands in. Every authenticated surface in the app is downstream of this page, and ~40 e2e specs enter through it.
